title: nyxloom typed agent result (CR-03, DR-13)
description: One agent judgement, bound to the identity it was produced for and to the raw output that evidences it. This document -- never a markdown file -- is what the controller reads. The enums here are generated-consistent with src/nyxloom/results.py and tests/test_results.py fails if they drift.

kind.description: The discriminator: which leg produced this result.

verdict.description: The outcome. Which of these a given kind may use is enforced by results.ADMISSIBLE_VERDICTS, not by this schema -- a per-kind conditional here would duplicate that table and the two would drift.

decline_reason.description: Required iff verdict is 'declined'; forbidden otherwise. A capability decline must name a mechanically checkable condition, so it can be corroborated rather than believed.

evidence.description: The raw agent output, persisted separately and bound by digest. Separate because raw output is not a contract and must never be parsed for authority; bound because evidence that can be edited afterwards does not support the judgement it accompanies.

summary.description: One human-readable paragraph. Rendered for people; never read for authority.

details.description: Kind-specific structured fields (oracle results, reject class, findings). Open by design: adding a detail must not require a schema bump, because details never carry authority.
